messages:
Nora T: Quick accessibility catch from the console audit: when users move between the left nav and the right-hand details rail via quick links, keyboard focus is not preserved and screen readers don't announce the rail open. Can we decide a pattern?
Ezra L: Pattern we use elsewhere: on open, set tabindex='-1' on the rail container and call .focus(), then try to restore a previously focused element inside if we have one. On close, return focus to the triggering control.
Sam P: +1. Implementation detail: store a small map keyed by rail id with a data-a11y-key for elements we want to restore to. On blur/update capture the current data-a11y-key. When opening, attempt to querySelector(`[data-a11y-key="${key}"]`) before falling back to the rail heading.
Nora T: That sounds good. Also noticed many icon-only toggles rely on title attributes. Title isn't reliable for SRs. We should use aria-labels and role=button on all icon-only controls.
Ezra L: Agreed. Also add aria-controls on the trigger and toggle aria-expanded to reflect state. If we want extra announcement, use a sr-only aria-live='polite' region that shows short messages like "Metrics rail expanded". Keep it minimal to avoid verbosity.
Sam P: Lighthouse run flagged three automated issues: (1) .chip--muted contrast 2.6:1, (2) .icon-btn focus ring is 1px and too thin, (3) multiple icon buttons missing accessible names.
aria-bot: ⚠️ Scan results: 3 issues (low contrast on .chip--muted, focus-outline insufficient on .icon-btn, missing accessible names on icon buttons). Re-run after fixes.
Nora T: Design action: propose token swaps for muted chips (neutral-600 tested to 4.6:1 on white) and define a 3px focus ring style for .icon-btn (use token accent-500 with sufficient contrast). Include dark-mode variants.
Ezra L: Dev action: I'll implement focus memory + focus return on close, add aria-expanded toggles, and wire an aria-live sr-only container. PR target: Wed.
Sam P: I'll do an icon accessibility sweep: replace title attrs with aria-labels, add role=button, ensure tabindex=0 when necessary. PR target: Thu. I'll also remove arrow-key handlers from plain card grids — unless we convert them to roving-tabindex composite widgets, arrow handlers will confuse keyboard users.
Nora T: Small copy tweak: status chips read as "ok" / "warn". Let's use full words like "Healthy" / "Degraded" so SRs read clearer states. Add to UX copy doc.
aria-bot: ✅ Automated note: re-run scan after PRs merge. Remaining programmatic issues will be listed if found.
Ezra L: I'll add unit tests that simulate keyboard nav and assert focus restoration and aria-expanded toggles.
Nora T: Thanks team. Please drop PR links here when ready and I'll do a final NVDA + VoiceOver pass after merges. :thumbsup:
